name: Gibran Rakabuming Raka
title: Vice President of the Republic of Indonesia
bio: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka spearheads national digital transformation, youth empowerment, and modern public administration. Working closely with President Prabowo, he drives the deployment of GovTech Indonesia (INA Digital), green economic transitions, and the modernization of MSMEs across all 38 Indonesian provinces.
